title: Preventing Sewer Gas Leakage in Unused Traps
description: Drain traps rely on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. In rarely used fixtures, floor drains, or seasonal plumbing, this liquid seal eventually evaporates, exposing the building to foul smells and potential health hazards. A simple professional solution is installing an automatic trap primer or regularly introducing water into infrequently used drains to restore the barrier. Checking water trap integrity during routine inspections protects indoor air quality and keeps drainage systems operating safely.

Preventing Sewer Gas Leakage in Unused Traps

Drain traps rely on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. In rarely used fixtures, floor drains, or seasonal plumbing, this liquid seal eventually evaporates, exposing the building to foul smells and potential health hazards. A simple professional solution is installing an automatic trap primer or regularly introducing water into infrequently used drains to restore the barrier. Checking water trap integrity during routine inspections protects indoor air quality and keeps drainage systems operating safely.
